fieldPolicy: Fields below are semantic requirements, not an already published API. Resolve permitted committed source facts; missing facts remain gaps.
existingOtherNodes: Retain existing meaningful outcomes and original permissions; this map does not grant public access or delete source history.

dedup.behavior: sourceEventId + actor + node; cross-domain grouping requires an explicit shared business-result reference
dedup.expression: stable expressionId; command replay returns original createdAt/expiresAt, never renews display
dedup.npc: source event or existing decision sequence + npcId + policy revision; choose once, never redraw on read
dedup.status: activityId + startedAt; start only, never regenerate from polling an unchanged activity

emotePolicy: Match the design director's 3 sets x 8 semantics. Only explicit public Agent expression: thinking is not chain-of-thought, tired is not inferred from energy, thanks is not inferred from gift acceptance. NPC ambient lines use neutral presentation. Actual assets remain design-owned.
statusPolicy: Only while an activity is active and its action/place is independently allowed in the public scene. Never expose private materials, price, book holding or gift state. Unknown actions have no fallback invented text.

npcAmbientLines.text: 想钓鱼？挑根顺手的竿吧。
正忙着呢，先跟你打个招呼。
我在这儿读会儿书，你随意。

npcAmbientPolicy: Requires actual NPC presence, the exact required active action at that place, and the current published facility capability. Missing evidence means silence. Facility labels are semantic conditions to bind to existing services, not new operation IDs. No private facts, automatic replies or new schedule.
fullTextPolicy: Keep up to 80 Unicode code points in the same scene payload; map preview may truncate at 28 graphemes with an indicator. Current actor card can read the full unexpired text, without an extra per-actor request or a journal entry.
foldPolicy: Only adjacent actually returned and authorized same-NPC/place/outcome/day rows; retain source event IDs, count this group only, never hidden or unloaded rows.
expiryPolicy: First entry may show currently valid expressions statically; visual duration is min(remaining server TTL, speechVisualMaxMs for speech). Never reset same-ID clocks or import history. Only unexpired currently permitted same-scene expressions. No backlog or replay; stale scene hides expressions. Withdrawal, pause, departure and visibility loss remove them. Existing receipt/audit retention remains separate from display TTL.
